pulse_source: heart_timeseries.json (this project's ORd-2011 + four-chamber elastance + Windkessel model); beat 9 of the simulation, resampled to 128 phase samples
palisade_declaration: NORMAL state: the distal oesophageal submucosal blood drains CAUDALLY into the left gastric vein and thence to the portal vein; the palisade channels carry it downward. VARICES state: portal pressure exceeds the systemic venous pressure, left gastric flow reverses (hepatofugal) and the palisade channels carry blood CRANIALLY into the azygos. Both states are prescribed, not solved: there is no pressure-flow network solver behind the switch. The 8.0 mm/s palisade velocity is a DECLARED value - no published palisade-zone velocity was located.
